articles.title: 69% of landlords to self-manage in two years, says survey
articles.summary: August survey reveals growing concerns over regulations, agent fees and tax reporting as property owners rethink management arrangements.
articles.ai_summary:

- The shift toward self-management reflects changing attitudes among property owners as they seek greater control and cost savings in their management strategies.
